name: Tabs
description: Text tabs with an accent underline on the selected tab. Single size — each tab is exactly 40px tall with a heading-4 label. TabGroup arranges Tabs horizontally with a 24px gap.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected tab — accent underline + full-strength label

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled — label stays subtle, underline drops to subtle when selected

props.name: forceState
props.description: Docs-only visual state forcing, mirrors Figma State axis

tokenBindings.background-color:underline:selected: --s2a-color-border-accent (NOT YET SHIPPED — Figma binds s2a/color/border/accent, #3b63fb fallback)
tokenBindings.font:label: --s2a-typography-*-heading-4 + --s2a-font-family-heading

notes: Selection is signaled by both color AND the underline shape — not color alone (1.4.1).
Roving tabindex: selected tab is tabbable (0), others -1. Arrow-key navigation between tabs must be wired by the consumer (this is a pure HTML/CSS package).
Selected+disabled underline uses content-subtle so state stays visible without implying interactivity.
Focus ring uses --s2a-color-focus-ring-default at 2px, same convention as Button (2.4.7).

knownGaps: --s2a-color-border-accent is bound in Figma (s2a/color/border/accent) but not yet published in @adobecom/s2a-tokens — CSS carries a #3b63fb fallback until the token ships.
